lavagna.title: Free whiteboard
lavagna.text: A clean whiteboard to write on and talk to UNLIM. Volumes always within reach. No circuits.

tutor.title: Full ELAB Tutor
tutor.text: The full app: Volume path, experiments, UNLIM, voice, simulator. Complete lesson with the class.

videolezioni.title: Video Lessons
videolezioni.text: Both TikTok kit videos, loaded right here without leaving the home page.

compile_home.title: Compile Arduino
compile_home.text: Write Arduino code with Blockly blocks or in C++. Compile + upload to the kit's Nano R4.

unlim_chat.title: Ask UNLIM
unlim_chat.text: Talk to UNLIM without leaving the home: lessons, experiments, citations from the Volumes.

hero.title: ELAB Tutor
hero.subtitle: Physical kits + textbooks + morphic software for the classroom

kits.title: Real physical kits
kits.body: Every student builds on the Omaric kit. Not just simulation — they touch, measure, and truly understand.

books.title: Printed textbooks
books.body: Three volumes written by the teachers who use the product. The software quotes Volume and page verbatim.

unlim.title: UNLIM AI tutor
unlim.body: UNLIM helps the teacher prepare the lesson and explain it to the class — it supports, never replaces.

morphic.title: Morphic software
morphic.body: The interface adapts to the class, the kit, the teacher. Same product, different shape for whoever uses it.

for_schools.title: For schools
for_schools.body: Designed for interactive whiteboards in primary and lower-secondary schools. PNRR and MePA compliant.

footer.credits: Homepage by Andrea Marro · Teodora de Venere

consent.age_intro: Before we start, tell us how old you are. We need to know so we can protect you better!
consent.child_text: This site uses 'cookies' (little helpers) to work better. Don't worry: we won't tell anyone your secrets!
consent.adult_text: This site collects anonymous information to improve the experience. Data is protected and not shared with third parties.
consent.coppa_body: If your child is under 13, consent must be given by a parent or legal guardian.
consent.parental_intro: You're under 14, so we need a parent's or guardian's permission. Don't worry, it's super quick!
consent.parental_explain: Write your mom or dad's email and we'll send them a message asking for permission.
consent.parental_note: In the meantime you can use ELAB in limited mode: your data stays only on this device.
consent.sent_intro: We sent an email to {{email}}. Ask your parent to confirm!
consent.sent_note: In the meantime you can keep using ELAB. Your data stays safe on this device only: no analytics, no data sent elsewhere.
consent.banner_text: We use technical cookies and pseudonymized data to improve the learning experience. No advertising tracking, no data sold. Parental consent is required for minors.
consent.essential_body: Required for the platform to function (authentication, security).
consent.analytics_body: Help us understand how the platform is used. No personal data.

chat.welcome:
**Hello, class! I'm UNLIM, the ELAB tutor. **

I help the teacher explain electronics using your kit and the textbooks. Ask anything: circuits, LEDs, resistors, Arduino, sensors, code — we're here to build together.
chat.error_generic: Something didn't work. Please try again in a moment.
chat.error_offline: It looks like you're offline. UNLIM needs the network to answer at its best.
chat.rate_limit: Lots of questions in a short time: let's wait a few seconds and try again.
